description: Score a ranked retrieval run against relevance judgements (qrels). Returns recall@k, precision@k, nDCG@k (graded, linear gain), hit rate@k and MRR, averaged over judged queries, plus per-query values. Deterministic; no model calls.

qrels.description: Relevance judgements: { queryId: { docId: grade } }. Grade 0 means not relevant; higher grades are more relevant (used by nDCG). Example: { "q1": { "d3": 2, "d7": 1 } }

run.description: Ranked retrieval output: { queryId: [docId, ...] }, best match first. Example: { "q1": ["d7", "d3", "d9"] }

name: evaluate_retrieval

missingFromRun.description: Judged queries absent from the run (scored as an empty ranking).

queries.description: Queries with at least one relevant document.

skippedQueries.description: Queries in qrels with no relevant documents (excluded from averages).

title: Evaluate retrieval
